s.note: the pub where everyone goes quiet
s.how: Score 600g pork rind, rub with flaky salt and dry uncovered in the fridge overnight. Roast at 240C for 30 minutes until blistered and crisp all over. Cool for 5 minutes and break into pieces. Stay on the road.

s.note: a Yorkshire pub classic on the bar
s.how: Boil 4 eggs for 6 minutes, cool and peel. Wrap each in 100g seasoned sausage mince. Roll in flour, 1 beaten egg and 100g panko. Fry at 170C for 7 minutes. Halve and serve with English mustard.

m.how: Brown 750g lamb mince. Add a diced onion and 2 carrots, then 2 tbsp tomato paste, 2 tbsp Worcestershire and 250ml stock and simmer 40 minutes. Top with 1kg potatoes mashed with 60g butter and bake at 200C for 25 minutes until golden.

w.how: Mix 250g self-raising flour, 125g shredded suet or cold grated butter, 30g sugar and 150ml water into a dough. Roll to a rectangle, spread with 200g raspberry jam, roll up and bake at 180C for 40 minutes. Serve with 500ml hot custard.

d.how: Leave four 500ml bottles of English ale out of the fridge for an hour so they're cool, not ice cold. Pour slowly into pint glasses and keep to the road, away from the moors.
